title.narrative: Peace and Conflict Resolution Evidence Platform (PCREP)

description.narrative: This proposal is for an Accountable Grant over six years (September 2021-Sept 2027) to develop cutting edge research to support a new approach to peace processes and sustaining peace. Previous FCDO-commissioned research demonstrates that conflicts typically end through negotiated settlement over decades (not years); that conflicts are becoming more politically complex (with more actors); and mediation and peace deals more technically detailed (in agreement provisions).
